# Generation four

This folder is a **workshop**, not a finished system. The system loop
(`quantlab_manager.system_loop`) writes `strategy.py` here, measures it, and
rewrites it — as many times as it takes — until one attempt beats the best
sealed 2026 result on record. When that happens this folder is frozen exactly as
it stands, `quantlab_system05/` opens, and the search starts again from a new
hypothesis. So the folder list is the trail of what actually worked.

**Nothing here is written by hand.** `strategy.py` is generated by a seat that
has no tools and cannot write files: it returns Python as a string, and
`quantlab_manager.sandbox` parses that string before anything imports it. Code
that could reach the filesystem or the network is refused rather than sandboxed,
which is why an unattended process is allowed to author it at all.

If you want to change how these are written, change the briefing in
`quantlab_manager/coder.py` or the gate in `quantlab_manager/sandbox.py`.
Editing `strategy.py` by hand will be overwritten on the next iteration.
